spec.bars: H1 bid/ask, Dukascopy hour candles 2025-01 onward (scripts/ingest_dukascopy_candles.py --hourly)

gates.t_day: t on the daily equal-weight book >= Bonferroni over every test ever registered
gates.late_entry: net > 0 when entering at the typical price (O+H+L+C)/4 of the entry hour, adverse side
gates.top_year_share: no calendar year contributes more than 50% of the total net

tiers.PASSED: every IX-2 gate, t_day >= the Bonferroni threshold
tiers.PROMISING: net > 0, costs x1.5 > 0, late entry > 0, >= 300 trades and t_day >= 2.0, but not PASSED
